title: Tags
summary: Compact static, selectable and removable labels with one explicit interaction owner.

kind.description: What the tag carries: a checkbox, an icon, a colour, an avatar, or nothing but its label. The compatibility input quantity is still accepted and means default.

status.description: What the tag reports, in the shared status vocabulary. Leave it empty for a tag that reports nothing.

appearance.description: Visual appearance, read from the neutral alpha ramp and separate from type: surface keeps a faint fill and a boundary, ghost keeps nothing until it is hovered. Only the neutral types take it, because a status tag carries its meaning in its colour.

size.description: Framework size token: sets the label text and the default spacing.

line.description: Takes the text line of this form size as an inline tag one size down, for a table cell, so the row keeps its control height. Overrides size and inline.

spacing.description: Block padding of a free-standing tag, with the names the buttons use.

inline.description: Sit on the text line of another control: no block padding, a flush label, and a remove button the height of the line. The host may publish --sf-tag--line.

count.description: Optional count shown with the default tag.

color-class.description: Framework semantic background utility for the color marker.

avatar-image-url.description: Avatar image URL; the visible text remains the accessible label.

root-class.description: Framework utility classes for the visible root.

avatar-status.description: Reserved avatar status value for compatible templates.

active.description: Selected state of a checkbox tag.

disabled.description: Disable interactive toggle and close actions.

closable.description: Show a separate remove action; icon, color and avatar tags enable it by default, a checkbox tag only when it is set.

interactive.description: Render the label as a button next to the remove action, for tags that open something (for example a filter chip menu); ignored for checkbox tags.

aria-label.description: Optional accessible name override for a selectable tag.

close-label.description: Accessible name of the remove action. Defaults to Remove, or Удалить on a Russian page.

type.description: Legacy name that answered both questions from one list: a content word reaches kind, a status word reaches status. See contracts/public-api-axes.json.

static.const: Default, icon, color, avatar and status tags are labels without an action role or Tab stop.

selection.const: Checkbox tags render one native toggle button and expose active through aria-pressed.

removal.const: A removable value keeps its surface static and exposes one separately named close action.

events.const: A successful toggle emits one change event; a successful removal emits one close event. Disabled controls emit neither.

presentation.const: Tag geometry uses semantic UI, typography, role-color and motion tokens; static tags do not gain action hover affordance.

onToggle.summary: Toggle an enabled checkbox tag and emit its new active state.

onClose.summary: Emit removal intent for an enabled closable tag.

change.summary: The active state of a checkbox tag changed.

close.summary: Removal was requested from the separately named close action.

component.description: The sf-tag element; the host removes it.

accessibility.focus: Only native toggle and close actions enter Tab order. Focus is keyboard-visible, geometry-stable and forced-colors-safe.

changes: Add interactive: the label becomes a native button beside the separate remove action, so the tag is reachable by Tab and opens with Enter or Space.
Without interactive the markup is unchanged.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-tag for a compact category, filter, selected value or status with an explicit static, toggle or remove owner.
do_not: Do not copy generated ui-smart code
Do not move host data or access decisions into the component
Do not make a static tag focusable
Do not nest a toggle and remove action in one tag surface
